name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.61 / build 62 includes the active-appointment booking screen, simpler shared dialogs and Medical History cards. Matching home-service operations use 7–9 AM, 9–11 AM and 1–3 PM windows, one patient per slot and three per date, with saved staff updates and reminders. Phone push delivery needs separate Expo/FCM configuration and is not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
